name: Shiori
message: "Hello."
"Hello."
(Bow)

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you for coming. Ehehe, I'm so happy."

name: Shiori
message: "First off... Ah, right. I should explain what I'm doing."

name: Shiori
message: "Remember how I told you I was still bound by physics yesterday? But since I'm a ghost, that didn't seem right to me."

name: Shiori
message: "So I tried experimenting a bit, seeing if I could float or maybe pass through walls."

name: Shiori
message: "And well, as you can see..."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm buried."

name: Shiori
message: "I didn't think I'd go down instead of up, but I did manage to break the laws of physics, so mission accomplished."

name: Shiori
message: "And since I'm already here, I figured I should let you see it. The blood is just a bonus, it doesn't hurt or anything."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm glad you got here early. Honestly, staying like this is pretty tough..."

name: Shiori
message: "I shouldn't even have a physical body, but the pressure is... insane. And being stuck here like this is really stressful."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh right, can you do me a favor? Before I get out, could you take a picture?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, wait. I need to look like a proper corpse first."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, this should be good. Go ahead."
(Take a photo)

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. Another entry for the Death Diary."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, now that you've taken a picture, it's time to get out of this cramped space."

name: Shiori
message: "Phew... freedom."

name: Shiori
message: "Sliding out of the ground like that feels so strange, even to me. It really reminds me that I'm a ghost."

name: Shiori
message: "Anyway, that's enough chatting for now. We should make good use of our time."

name: Shiori
message: "Shall we go see Ms. Librarian? She might've found some promising cases or accidents for us."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, let's go. I'm counting on you again."
(Library)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Well, you're back fast."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, maybe I was a little too excited. I'm not trying to rush you. I can come back another day."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please wait. I've already gathered a few—"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "This may sound like an odd question, but when was the last time you came here?"

name: Shiori
message: "Eh? That would be yesterday..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I see. So a full day has passed. My apologies. Please disregard what I just said."

name: Shiori
message: "When you're really focused, time just flies, doesn't it? Thank you. I appreciate how seriously you've been taking this."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No, that isn't quite what I meant."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's true that I was focused, but the problem lies with my cognition."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I still have most of my memories, and my ego remains intact. But my sense of time has become distorted."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It seems my soul itself has aged—no, perhaps it would be more accurate to say it has deteriorated."

name: Shiori
message: "So although you don't age, your cognition is starting to fail. Is that right?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It appears so. I may say strange things now and then, but please just ignore them."

name: Shiori
message: "...By the way, you don't have to answer this if it's hard for you, but..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes?"

name: Shiori
message: "Aside from memories and sense of time, is there anything more we can lose?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Who knows? At least as far as I know, there isn't."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "For most, before their sense of time fails, they lose their memories, their ego, and eventually..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...they depart before I do."

name: Shiori
message: "Is there some secret to how you've managed to keep your memories and ego for so long?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Fixation. To books."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "To read every book that exists in this world. Ridiculous, I know, but it's been my goal since I was alive."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Losing my sanity would mean being unable to read anymore. That fixation—no, that obsession—is what keeps me intact, I suppose."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "This library never stops adding new books to its shelves. And with no end in sight, I've been able to maintain my sense of self after all these years."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And, if I'm ever allowed to wish for one more thing—"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I've strayed too far from our topic. Let's get to the point."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, it was because I asked something weird."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No, not at all. In fact, I realized something from our talk just now."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Ghosts who linger for too long develop distorted senses of time. But this has yet to happen to you, correct?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. I think... I'm still fine."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, and look. I got this notebook yesterday."

name: Shiori
message: "A Death Diary, for recording my fixation—my deaths."

name: Shiori
message: "My buddy bought it for me."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A Death Diary, is it? I see."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I had considered the possibility that you had been a ghost for about as long as I have, but it seems I can rule that out."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "My apologies for making you stand through such a long conversation. Please, take a seat."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, thank you."
(Take a seat)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Now then, let me give you the results of my investigation."

name: Shiori
message: "Please do."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I should say this in advance, but I only skimmed through a large volume of materials, so I may have missed some incidents or accidents."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That said, this area is known to be quite safe, so setting accidents aside, there haven't been many actual incidents to begin with."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Narrowing the victims down to young women reduces that number even further. Within the last ten years, I found only three cases."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "First, a hit-and-run incident, seven years ago. A high school girl on a bicycle was struck by a car."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She was taken to the hospital in critical condition, or so the report said. Whether she died afterward is unknown."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Next, another traffic accident, five years ago. This was on a much larger scale; several pedestrians were involved."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Three people suffered minor to serious injuries. Only one person—a high school girl—was unlucky enough to lose her life."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Lastly, two years ago. This one involved an adult woman, likely not your age, but I'll mention it just in case."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "After stabbing her partner to death, she slit her own wrists and committed suicide."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That's all of them. Do any of these stand out to you?"

name: Shiori
message: "If I had to choose, I'd say the accident from five years ago."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "May I ask why?"

name: Shiori
message: "It's nothing major, but we found an article online yesterday about a high school girl who committed suicide."

name: Shiori
message: "And that was also five years ago. That's all. It's probably just a coincidence."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A coincidence... I see."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Shall I look into the incidents and accidents from five years ago in more detail?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "While it isn't good to read too much into things, perhaps there's more to this. Something may have happened five years ago."

name: Shiori
message: "That's why it's bothering me... I don't have definite proof, but I also can't just brush it off..."

name: Shiori
message: "That's right, maybe I should follow my gut more."

name: Shiori
message: "Could I ask you to continue looking into the cases from five years ago?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Of course. Leave it to me."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "So, where exactly did the accident happen?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "The newspapers didn't mention the precise location."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It was a major accident. You might be able to find the details online."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, thank you."
(Bow in gratitude)
(Strike a pose of immense gratitude)
(Strike a pose of immense gratitude)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "There's no need to thank me. I'm simply another collaborator, like you."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, true. And thank you as well, for sticking with me, buddy."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I appreciate the sentiment, but please refrain from sudden movements like that. It startles me."

name: Shiori
message: "I think my buddy's trying to thank you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'm impressed you understood that... In any case, you don't need to thank me. I'll accept the sentiment, though."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Well then, until next time. Come back whenever you like. I'll be here, looking into it."

name: Shiori
message: "Please do. Okay, shall we get going?"

name: Shiori
message: "Now then. Could I ask you to start searching the internet right away?"

name: Shiori
message: "Let's sit on that bench again and—"

name: Elderly Man
message: "Excuse me, do you have a moment?"

name: Elderly Man
message: "Sorry for springing this on you out of nowhere, but I wanted to ask..."

name: Elderly Man
message: "You're the one who sat in that spot at the library, right? The seat no one else ever uses?"

name: Elderly Man
message: "This might be strange of me to ask, but... can you see things people normally can't?"

name: Elderly Man
message: "...Like ghosts, for example."
"Yes."
"No."

name: Elderly Man
message: "Ah... right, of course. Sorry for the strange question. Well then..."

name: Shiori
message: "And there he goes. You don't know him, do you?"

name: Shiori
message: "I think you made the right call not telling him. Anyone who asks you if you can see ghosts out of the blue is definitely suspicious."

name: Shiori
message: "It does bother me a little, though. An empty seat... ghosts... maybe he meant Ms. Librarian?"

name: Shiori
message: "If he were only after ghost stories, he wouldn't have looked that serious..."

name: Shiori
message: "He must've had his reasons... Well, there's no point dwelling on it."

name: Elderly Man
message: "Ah, I see... I thought so."

name: Elderly Man
message: "Your gaze was rather unnatural, so I figured that was the case."

name: Elderly Man
message: "There are people like that from time to time. People who can see those kinds of things, like you."

name: Elderly Man
message: "I don't have that gift, though."

name: Elderly Man
message: "She's... Tomoko-san's still there, isn't she?"
"Yes."
"No."
"I don't know."

name: Elderly Man
message: "Sh-She is...? A-Are you sure?"

name: Elderly Man
message: "I see... I see, so she's still..."

name: Elderly Man
message: "Sorry for holding you up. Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "...And there he goes."

name: Shiori
message: "Tomoko-san... He must've meant Ms. Librarian."

name: Shiori
message: "You went along with him pretty casually. Don't tell me you actually know Ms. Librarian's real name—"

name: Shiori
message: "—Right, of course not. You just nodded on impulse. It's written all over your face."

name: Shiori
message: "That man... he knew Ms. Librarian was sitting there, even though he claimed he couldn't see ghosts."

name: Shiori
message: "He couldn't see me at all, either. I wonder what he was after."

name: Shiori
message: "Did they know each other when she was alive?"

name: Shiori
message: "He looked so troubled... They must've been close in some way."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sensing romance."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm reeeeeeeally curious right now, but I think it wouldn't be right to pry."

name: Shiori
message: "I think I should tell her about him... But for now, I should worry about myself first."

name: Elderly Man
message: "Ah, no, I mean, the one with glasses, black hair—"

name: Elderly Man
message: "No, I'm sorry. That was a strange question. Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "...And there he goes."

name: Shiori
message: "By Tomoko-san, did he mean Ms. Librarian?"

name: Shiori
message: "I think you were right not to assume too much."

name: Shiori
message: "Even if Ms. Librarian really is this Tomoko-san, she might not want anyone to know she's still here."

name: Shiori
message: "But... I didn't sense any malice from him. He looked desperate, even... Maybe it wouldn't hurt to tell her about him."

name: Shiori
message: "But for now, I should take care of myself before meddling in other people's affairs."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, let's sit on the bench and start searching online."

name: Shiori
message: "Umm, right... as for the keywords... Just typing in 'accident' probably won't do."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe something like: a location name, plus major traffic accident. And... five years ago. I really should've asked which month it happened..."
(Five years ago, Hikarigadai, major traffic accident)

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, maybe it's this one?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Yeah. This is it. Three injured, from minor to severe. One high school girl dead."

name: Shiori
message: "There's a photo of the scene too, but... hmm... this alone doesn't tell us much..."

name: Shiori
message: "What do you think... Ah, okay, your face is telling me you're just as confused."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's try checking other news sites—"

name: Shiori
message: "...They're pretty much the same, no specific addresses. And I don't think we can pinpoint anything with just photos."
No addresses on social media either, only photos.

name: Shiori
message: "Hmm~... I see. Hey, can I borrow your phone? Ah, keep the screen as is."

name: Shiori
message: "I'll show the photo to Ms. Librarian and ask. You wait here."

name: Shiori
message: "Well then, I'll be back."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm back."

name: Shiori
message: "No luck. She doesn't know either."

name: Shiori
message: "The only other person who probably knows this area well enough is Gyaruko-san."

name: Shiori
message: "She's usually at that convenience store, but there's no guarantee she's actually there right now..."

name: Shiori
message: "It'd be a pain to run around looking for her. How about we try something first?"

name: Shiori
message: "Right, let's try calling her."

name: Shiori
message: "She called you before, so maybe we can call her back."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe she got added to your contacts without you noticing, or got registered as a friend in an app."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, to be honest, I'm actually just curious. Could you at least check?"
There's a garbled name in my contacts.

name: Shiori
message: "It's really there... I never thought it'd show up, but there it is... just like that..."

name: Shiori
message: "That's Gyaruko-san, right...? Should we try calling her? What do you think?"
(Call her)

name: Shiori
message: "You didn't even think twice about it, did you...? That was so cool."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yooo, hey hey~"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, good. It really was Gyaruko-san."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hm? Whaddya mean by that?"

name: Shiori
message: "Your name was garbled, so we couldn't tell who it was."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Whoa, creepy. That's straight-up paranormal."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I mean, I freaked out too. My phone, like, suddenly rang outta nowhere. Total jump scare."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, but there's something we want to ask you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Sure, what's up?"

name: Shiori
message: "It's about the scene of an accident that happened five years ago—"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "A scene?"

name: Shiori
message: "I was hoping to show you the photo, but we can't really do that over a phone call."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Just send it over then—or not. I dunno if it'll even reach me. It's already a miracle we can talk over the phone like this."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But you're talking about *that*, right? The accident site? You wanna know where it is?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yup, that's right. I thought you might know. We couldn't figure it out ourselves."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I might not know either, but I *can* point you to someone who probably does."

name: Shiori
message: "Really? Thank you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You know the supermarket, right? The one near the station?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "There's some granny hanging around who's really into gossip. She's a ghost too, like us."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "She just keeps talking, like, nonstop, all by herself, even when no one's listening. You'll know it's her right away."

name: Shiori
message: "A talkative lady near the supermarket. Got it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, right~. There's one more ghost who could help you out. She knows a lot, but uh, in a different way."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I think she was over... uh, how do I put it?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You know that huge park? Near the convenience store I'm always at?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Near that park, there's this huge parking lot. D'you know it?"

name: Shiori
message: "A parking lot... Yes, I think so."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Good, good. There's this super flashy girl there. You'll know it's her right away."

name: Shiori
message: "A super flashy girl, got it. Thank you."
"Thank you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yep yep, you're welcome~. Okay, later~"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, about what we found out yesterday—"

name: Shiori
message: "...She hung up. Guess we'll tell her another time."

name: Shiori
message: "The middle-aged lady near the supermarket, and the flashy girl at the parking lot."

name: Shiori
message: "Gyaruko-san said the girl was 'knowledgeable in a different way'... She was definitely hinting at something."

name: Shiori
message: "I'll let you decide where to go next."
(Supermarket)
(Parking lot)

name: Shiori
message: "The supermarket near the station... Looks like we're here."

name: Shiori
message: "She said we'd spot her right away, but—"

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, that's definitely her."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Hey, did you hear? The Suzuki boy failed his college exams again. You'd think he'd give up already, but he's still trying for med school."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "By the way, about the Suzukis, the husband turned out good, but the wife never went to college. Poor thing. The boy must take after her."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "But if you look at the Nakanishi family, the wife is also just a high school grad, yet their daughter landed a great job. They must have connections. Yes, that's it. That has to be it."

name: Shiori
message: "Just like Gyaruko-san said, she really has been talking nonstop this whole time. Alone, no less..."

name: Shiori
message: "Or rather... she's just rambling on and on at the living. What's more..."

name: Shiori
message: "She's not exactly talking about the nicest of things..."

name: Shiori
message: "Hmmm..."

name: Shiori
message: "She's probably not the type you'd normally want to get involved with... but she does look like she knows a lot..."

name: Shiori
message: "And after dragging you around this far, we can't exactly just go back empty-handed..."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, I'll work up the courage and talk to her."

name: Shiori
message: "You wait here. I can handle this—"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You two."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What are you doing out here at this hour? What about school?"

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, um, we're not..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Wandering around a place like this so early in the morning? Don't blame me if the police pick you up."

name: Shiori
message: "No, it's not morning anymore, and I don't go to school since I'm already—"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Kids these days. Honestly, I have no idea what goes on in their heads. Just look at Aoi's girl. I swear she's up to something sleazy."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, um, I'm actually a ghost like you—"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You really should study you know isn't it embarrassing not being a college graduate these days even girls go to college get jobs and work if you can catch a good husband like I did you can be a housewife but who knows if you'll ever manage that you need to be independent and think about your future oh that reminds me just successful isn't enough just look at Yasuda Sr. and Yasuda Jr. make sure you don't fall for guys like them."

name: Shiori
message: "She's not listening to me at all... Also, her sense of time seems a bit off... Just like Ms. Librarian."

name: Shiori
message: "No, it's not just her sense of time... Hmmm..."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm not sure she can even hold a proper conversation... Let's just ask what we need to and leave right away."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You know I don't like Yasuda-san one bit why did he even get elected there's definitely something shady going on people who look nice on the surface are always hiding something..."
(Ask about the scene of the accident)
(Let one second pass)

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh, right. Did you hear? Takeuchi's husband is cheating, I tell you, cheating. I saw it myself, him in a cafe with some woman. Not his wife, but a young girl. A really young one at that."
(Ask about the scene of the accident)
(Let one second pass)

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Wasn't he supposed to be from a good university when the woman's smart I guess the man always cheats that's just how men are they go for dumb girls..."
(Ask about the scene of the accident)
(Let one second pass)

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What in the world is wrong with you?! Stop interrupting me!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Now where was I? Ah, right! Kasukabe-san was feeding stray cats again. I swear, people like that never think about who has to clean up all the poop!"

name: Shiori
message: "Well, this is a bind... We'll set off her trigger if we interrupt her."

name: Shiori
message: "But just listening to her won't get us anywhere. We'll have to push through."

name: Shiori
message: "Can you lend me your phone? I'll handle this."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh, right! It's a shame about the Kirishikis. Their daughter was such a good kid, and then that happened. I heard she was hanging out with delinquents—"

name: Shiori
message: "At this rate, we'll be stuck listening to her go on and on forever..."

name: Shiori
message: "We're going to have to force our way through. Can you lend me your phone? I'll try doing something about this."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "The Uribayashi family's no better. Look at what happened to their daughter. Well, they reaped what they sowed."

name: Shiori
message: "Um, ma'am?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "If the daughter turned out like that, the parents must be the same. Yes, they only got their just desserts, I say. This world isn't all sunshine, you know? That's just how it works."

name: Shiori
message: "Ma'am."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What?! What's with that phone? You're not taking pictures, are you? What are you pointing it at me for?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'd like you to take a look at this screen. This article—"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh will you shut up already?! I'm not done talking—"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh, this! Isn't this that accident? How frightening! It was an awful story."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank goodness, she took the bait... Do you know about it?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh, will you shut up already?! I'm not done talking, let me finish!"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... Her trigger sets off if you interrupt her. I messed up..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh, this! Isn't this that accident? How frightening! It was an awful story."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? Ah, y-yes. Do you know about it?"

name: Shiori
message: "Hm? Yes?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You look just like her."

name: Shiori
message: "...Her? Who would that be?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You know, that idol! The one who was huge back in the 80s, the one all the girls copied their hairstyle from!"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, um, sorry, who...?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "She disappeared right at the peak of her popularity, and no one's heard a peep since. I wonder what she's doing now."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "We don't even know if she's still alive. There's no news at all."

name: Shiori
message: "Um... ma'am? About the accident..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Huh? What? What about the accident?"

name: Shiori
message: "On the phone. Please look at the screen. Do you know anything about it?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Know anything? Of course I do! How could I not?! It happened right over there! Look, just over there!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Yes, there! That place, the flower garden! A runaway car tore through the street! I heard it ran over like twenty people!"

name: Shiori
message: "The flower garden..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "But I know what's going on. I know who they were after. Aoi-san's daughter! That's right, Lumina-chan!"

name: Shiori
message: "Aoi, Lumina-san?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Yes! They were aiming for her! With all the rumors about that girl, it had to be some love affair gone wrong! No doubt about it!"

name: Shiori
message: "...Thank you very much, ma'am."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I mean, Lumina-chan was the only one who died, you know? There has to be more to it! That was no coincidence, I tell you! There's a huge conspiracy—"

name: Shiori
message: "If you'll excuse us."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I'm always right, you see. People always say I have amazing deduction and observation skills. I naturally see through things even when I don't want to. No conspiracy is safe from me—"

name: Shiori
message: "I feel bad leaving when she's still talking, but let's go. There's no telling when she'll stop."

name: Shiori
message: "Phew... Well, that was... something. But I'm glad we got some info."

name: Shiori
message: "Still... now that we know the victim's name, it's clear I wasn't the one who died in that accident."

name: Shiori
message: "...No. I might not even be Kugayama Shiori. Since we've come this far, I should go see it with my own eyes."

name: Shiori
message: "We also don't know how reliable her story is."

name: Shiori
message: "She did say around twenty people died, which is clearly an exaggeration..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Hey, you there! Ma'am! You bought your scallions THERE?! You should've gone to the other supermarket, they're way cheaper today!"

name: Shiori
message: "She's still not done... We should get away while we still can."

name: Shiori
message: "So, um, this might sound a little strange, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Remember what that lady said? That I resemble someone?"

name: Shiori
message: "That idol... Do you know her—No, you don't look like you do."

message: "I know this is a weird question, but... do you think there's a chance I used to be an idol?"
"I do."
"I don't."

name: Shiori
message: "Right... of course I don't."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, I was just curious. Forget I asked."

name: Shiori
message: "I don't think I do... but I guess part of me was hoping. Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, that's enough of that. No more silly expectations. Let's focus on the task at hand."

name: Shiori
message: "Before we go to the accident site, how about visiting that other person Gyaruko-san mentioned? The one who supposedly knows a lot?"

name: Shiori
message: "They might know the exact location or more details about the accident too, and..."

name: Shiori
message: "I don't really want to say this, but... I'm not sure how much of that supermarket lady's story we should believe..."

name: Shiori
message: "Of course, there's no guarantee the other person will have any useful info. As for how true that lady's story is, we'll know once we go there ourselves."

name: Shiori
message: "...Yeah, this is it. No doubt about it."

message: "Thank goodness, we finally found it. I was starting to doubt that lady's story..."

name: Shiori
message: "...Yes, right here. It was around this spot."

name: Shiori
message: "This is where... Aoi Lumina-san was hit by a car and died."

name: Shiori
message: "There's a fair amount of traffic. Maybe the car came up onto the sidewalk through that gap in the guardrail over there."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe the driver fell asleep at the wheel. I can't say for sure, though, since the article didn't give any details."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sure it was an accident, though. Not some targeted attack like that lady said."

name: Shiori
message: "What a stroke of bad luck... it hurts to even think about it."

name: Shiori
message: "I know it's a bit late for me to say this, but I'm sorry for dragging you into something so morbid, for making you go around visiting places where people died."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's just get this over with. I guess I'll go get hit by a car now."

name: Shiori
message: "If I really am Aoi Lumina and not Kugayama Shiori, I'll definitely remember something."

name: Shiori
message: "...I need to stand in the middle of the road, right? Since I'm supposed to get run over and all... I could never do this if I weren't a ghost. My heart's racing!"

name: Shiori
message: "...Yeah. Okay, here I go."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, and can you take my photo this time too? I need to put it in my Death Diary."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, the light just turned red... Perfect."

name: Shiori
message: "...This should be a good spot, I think."

name: Shiori
message: "Whew~... I'm so nervous. I know it won't hurt, but scary things are still scary..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, since we're already here, could you take a picture of the impact too? I'll make sure to go flying."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? Doesn't that mean..."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait—no—the car—ahhh!"
What...?

name: Shiori
message: "...That's enough picture taking for now. I'll head back."

name: Shiori
message: "Could you... let me see the photo?"

message: "Could you... at least let me explain myself?"
"Yes."
"No."

name: Shiori
message: "...Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "No. Please, hear me out."

name: Shiori
message: "Being run over by a car means physically getting in its way, right?"

name: Shiori
message: "In short, there's a high chance the car will take some kind of hit.

name: Shiori
message: "If the driver hits something invisible, they're definitely going to panic, right?"

name: Shiori
message: "What if they mess up the steering? What if they freak out and lose control?"

name: Shiori
message: "They might end up hitting a living person. They might even crash into you."

name: Shiori
message: "When the thought crossed my mind... I just couldn't do it. That would be way beyond inconsiderate."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm so glad I practiced phasing through things... I never expected to use it like this, though."

name: Shiori
message: "Anyway... I'm sorry. I won't go throwing myself at cars anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "I do want my memories back, but I don't want to drag others into it... Well, aside from you, I guess."

name: Shiori
message: "If I'm the type to hesitate like this, then I'm probably not Aoi Lumina-san, and I probably didn't die in that traffic accident... I think."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, but... we can't really jump to a conclusion without even trying..."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, I know! I've got the perfect solution!"

name: Shiori
message: "What if I crash into a parked car instead, and just get a taste of what it's like to be run over?"

name: Shiori
message: "If I don't feel anything, that means I didn't die in a traffic accident."

name: Shiori
message: "Wow, I'm a genius. Wait here for a bit. I'm going to crash into a parked car."

name: Shiori
message: "Hey. I know I'm a ghost, but... do you think I'd leave a scratch if I did that?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Right, of course you wouldn't know. What was I thinking?"

name: Shiori
message: "I mean... aren't cars expensive? I'm sure the owner would be pretty upset if I left a scratch."

name: Shiori
message: "I... I'm more timid than I thought! I'm scared! I don't want to bother people!"

name: Shiori
message: "People say I'm weird, but it seems I have some decency, at least."

name: Shiori
message: "I couldn't reenact the accident, but I did remember a little about myself."

name: Shiori
message: "I guess it does feel a bit forced. Was that no good? Let's just call it a small success, then..."

name: Shiori
message: "I mean, what else can we do? I can't do what I can't do. There's nothing we can do about that."

name: Shiori
message: "Could you... show me the photo again?"

name: Shiori

name: Shiori

name: Shiori

name: Shiori
message: "Well, I guess we've technically met today's objective. More or less... I think."

name: Shiori
message: "Gyaruko-san did mention another ghost who knows a lot, but I don't think we need to bother going anymore. I've found out enough."

name: Shiori

name: Shiori

name: Shiori

name: Shiori
message: "Now, then. We found the accident site and even got to try the urban legend ourselves. In short, we've cleared all of today's objectives."

name: Shiori
message: "I was a little worried, but it looks like we came to the right place."

name: Shiori
message: "Look. That must be her."

name: Shiori
message: "She looks flashy, but not quite. Is this what they call 'jirai-kei'? Her outfit really stands out."

name: Shiori
message: "Also, I can somehow feel it. She's just like me."

name: Shiori
message: "I know it's strange of me to say this... but this town sure has a lot of ghosts. I wonder if it's like this everywhere."

name: Shiori
message: "Anyway, let's go talk to her. I hope she's willing to listen..."
"Hello."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, I know this is a bit sudden, but... you're a ghost, aren't you? I'm a ghost too."

name: Shiori
message: "Could you spare us a moment to talk? We won't take much of your time."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "You sure about that?"

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "I am a sinner, an evil spirit who has committed countless crimes."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Get involved with me, and I might just drag you to hell too."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Are you prepared to face the consequences?"

name: Shiori
message: "An... evil spirit? You don't look like it to me, though..."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "I am a soul bound by darkness, chained here without escape."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Now leave, before the darkness of the abyss swallows you whole too."

name: Shiori
message: "Um, you mean this place is dangerous?"

name: Shiori
message: "...What should we do? She hasn't even heard us out yet."
(Show her a photo of the scene)
(Talk to her while watching her reaction)

name: Shiori
message: "...Nothing ever fazes you, does it? You never fail to amaze."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Hm? What's with the photo?"

name: Shiori
message: "It's the scene of an accident five years ago. We're looking for it because of... circumstances."

name: Shiori
message: "Right. She doesn't seem dangerous so far. Let's try asking her."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "...? About what?"

name: Shiori
message: "Could you take a look at this photo?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "...A photo of an accident?"

name: Shiori
message: "It's the scene of an accident five years ago. We're looking for it because of... circumstances."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "And that would be?"

name: Shiori
message: "I have no memories. And to get them back, I want to figure out how I died."

name: Shiori
message: "So my buddy here is helping me out. Ah, my buddy's alive, by the way. Definitely not a ghost."

name: Shiori
message: "Which gives me access to things ghosts can't, like the internet."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "...This place in the photo. Is this where you died?"

name: Shiori
message: "I don't know yet. Maybe I'll remember once I'm there."

name: Shiori
message: "Do you know anything about it? A big accident happened there. Three people were injured, and one even died."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "No, I don't."

name: Shiori
message: "I see... Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "Can I ask you one more thing? Gyaruko-san told me you're really knowledgeable."

name: Shiori
message: "The girl who's always hanging out in front of the convenience store."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... if you're here all the time, you might not know what I mean. But I think you've met her before..."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "...I think I know. That girl, right?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, we're probably thinking of the same person."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "...Sorry, but I only know about urban legends. Normal accidents don't interest me."

name: Shiori
message: "Urban legends... so that's what she meant by 'in a different way.'"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "I can tell you more, if you're interested."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Who knows? Your death might have something to do with an urban legend."

name: Shiori
message: "Urban legends... like yokai, right? Are you saying things like that actually exist?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "If ghosts like us exist, is it really so strange for aberrations to exist too?"

name: Shiori
message: "Right. That makes sense."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's say I died not from an incident or an accident, but because of an urban legend..."

name: Shiori
message: "If that were the case, it's possible my body was never found..."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "It happens. In parallel-world urban legends."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "If you died in another world and only your soul returned, a lot of things would make sense."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "...I've heard of similar cases."

name: Shiori
message: "So it really does happen... Maybe I..."

name: Shiori
message: "Could you tell me more about these urban legends?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "I see, so you've resolved yourself to be consumed by the darkness."

name: Shiori
message: "Eh? Ah, um... Yes. Hm? Ah, right. Yes."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Then I'll teach you an easy one nearby."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, please."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Head straight east from here and take the third intersection."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Then stand on the manhole cover at the center of the intersection for ten seconds."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "If the two of you have been chosen, you'll reach a world that is neither this one nor the next."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Your body might be there."

name: Shiori
message: "Stand on the manhole for ten seconds, got it. How do we get back?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Don't accept their invitation."

name: Shiori
message: "Their... invitation?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "As long as you don't move away from the manhole, you'll be fine. If you stay put, you can come back."

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Remember, *never* step off the manhole. As long as you follow that, you're safe."

name: Shiori
message: "Perfect for a test run, then. Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right. What should we call you?"

name: Shiori
message: "Since we're ghosts, I guess it's better if we don't know your real name, but... would it be okay if I gave you some kind of nickname?"

name: Jirai-kei Girl
message: "Anything's fine, but if I had to pick..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Kashima, Reiko."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Call me Kashima Reiko."

name: Shiori
message: "Kashima-san, then."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Kashima Reiko."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Call me Kashima Reiko."

name: Shiori
message: "Kashima... Reiko-san?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Right, Kashima Reiko."

name: Shiori
message: "So, um, as for me—"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Don't. Don't make me shoulder any more sins."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You are merely passing by, a ghost with no relation to me."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Understood?"

name: Shiori
message: "Um... Yes, I understand."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Now go, before I rob you of your lives."

name: Shiori
message: "......Okay then, thank you for the info."
"Thank you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I merely helped you on a whim."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Now go. I have nothing more to say."

name: Shiori
message: "...Was that what they call, 'chuunibyo'? I think we'd get along, though."

name: Shiori
message: "She was kind enough to tell us about the urban legend. I'd love to check it out right away, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Whether we actually go is up to you."

name: Shiori
message: "It'd be dangerous if an aberration actually appeared, and I doubt it has anything to do with how I died."

name: Shiori
message: "So yeah, I'm interested, but I'd feel bad dragging you into danger."

name: Shiori
message: "In short, it's not a priority. But if you're interested, we can check it out."

name: Shiori
message: "The third intersection... There's a manhole too. This is probably the place."

name: Shiori
message: "There are quite a number of people passing by. The cars... not a lot. Just some passing by once in a while."

name: Shiori
message: "With people around, standing on a manhole for ten seconds is harder than I thought... We'd be like total weirdos."

name: Shiori
message: "So the odds that I died here are low. Even I wouldn't do something that weird—"

name: Shiori
message: "Actually, I would. Yes, I'd definitely prioritize curiosity over shame."

name: Shiori
message: "But... hmmm... I don't really feel anything click despite coming all the way here. Plus, I don't want to put you in danger..."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe we should just stop. It'd be bad if we actually ended up in another world."
(Step on the manhole)

name: Shiori
message: "You didn't even think twice... Wait, let me join you."
We're both on the manhole.

name: Shiori
message: "Ten seconds, right? I hope no cars show up..."

message: "Ten seconds is longer than I thought. Maybe five more?"

name: Shiori
message: "Three, two, one..."

name: Shiori
message: "Looks like it was a dud. Nothing happened—"

name: Shiori
message: "The air's changed. Are we... in the other world? I wasn't entirely convinced earlier, but to think it was actually true..."

name: Shiori
message: "It's so silent it's unsettling... And look, over there."
No matter which direction we turn, the same scenery stretches on and on.

message: "No! That wasn't me—"

message: "Ehehe!"

name: Shiori
message: "...Are you okay? You're okay, right? ...Good, I'm relieved."

name: Shiori
message: "Phew... that was scary. I didn't think it would use my voice to trick you..."

name: Shiori
message: "How strange. My heart isn't beating, but I'm all jittery."

name: Shiori
message: "We didn't find my corpse, and I didn't regain any memories, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "I was probably into thrills like that... No, that's not it."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe I liked urban legends, or the occult in general. Somehow, it just feels that way."

name: Shiori
message: "I must've loved the extraordinary, back when I was alive."

name: Shiori
message: "I still think it's unlikely that I died because of an urban legend, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "These urban legends might help me learn more about myself."

name: Shiori
message: "Hey, if you're interested, let's see Kashima Reiko-san again."

name: Shiori
message: "I want to try the other urban legends. With you."

name: Shiori
message: "They may be unrelated to my memories, but I'm sure more thrills await. Like what we went through just now."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, that was scary, but it was fun. Well? What about you?"
"It was fun."
"It was scary."

name: Shiori
message: "I know, right? I had fun too."

name: Shiori
message: "But... I'd rather not step on a manhole for a while. Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, is that so? Then I guess I shouldn't drag you into it next time..."

name: Shiori
message: "I had a lot of fun, but... I'd rather not step on a manhole for a while. Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "Anyway, that wraps up our otherworldly adventure."

name: Shiori
message: "Nice job, and thanks for coming along with me. I'm really glad we made it back safely."

name: Shiori
message: "I can't believe we actually experienced a real urban legend. We should go thank Kashima Reiko-san and tell her what happened."

name: Shiori
message: "She might even tell us about another one. Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "Now then, we should go."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I see... So you really did get transported to another world."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. It was a rather thrilling experience, thank you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Did you find any leads on your corpse?"

name: Shiori
message: "Not really. Honestly, I'm just glad we made it back in one piece."

name: Shiori
message: "If it weren't for your warning, who knows what would've happened. I can't believe it'd try something so underhanded."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Underhanded?"

name: Shiori
message: "It mimicked my voice and told my buddy it was safe. It almost got us."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "......It never did that to me."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh... Is that so?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Yeah. Maybe it was because I was alone."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I thought I was pointing you to one of the less dangerous urban legends I've verified. My bad."

name: Shiori
message: "I see... You're so kind. Thank you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I am nothing more than a sinner. I've long cast away my kindness."

name: Shiori
message: "Hmmm... yes, you're right. Sorry, I'll take that back."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It's not like... I'm being nice or anything."

name: Shiori
message: "Hm? Yes, I understand."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "The way that aberration reacted bothers me. You might be cursed... or even possessed."

name: Shiori
message: "Well, that's... scary."

message: "......Your phone. Show me the map."

message: "There's a shrine at this spot."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It's pretty rundown, but it's filled with strong divine energy."

name: Shiori
message: "Divine energy?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You can think of it as a place filled with sacred power."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, I see. You mean a deity's aura, hence divine energy."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Yeah. If you're ever feeling uneasy, try going there."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It should push away anything tainted."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, so you're telling my buddy to get purified. Thank you, you really are kind."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, I won't say it again."

name: Shiori
message: "It just occurred to me, but... In a way, I'm already haunting you, aren't I?"

name: Shiori
message: "What if the purification ends up exorcising me? Ah, but I *do* want to pass on, so I guess that's fine...?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "That may be true for a denizen of darkness such as I, but you don't look that way."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You'll probably be safe. There's no need to worry."

name: Shiori
message: "That's a relief. Thank you for letting me know."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Like I said, I'm not telling you this out of kindness."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I merely offered you a way out before my darkness devours you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I don't want to shoulder any more sins. In other words, I'm doing this for myself."
"Thank you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Now go. I don't want to get chummy with you."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, we'll be off now—Ah, right!"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...You still want something?"

name: Shiori
message: "If you don't mind, could you tell us about another urban legend sometime?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'll have one ready before we meet again."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, thanks. See you again."

name: Shiori
message: "She puts on a cold front, but you can tell she's a good person. She really is kind. I'm not telling her that again, though."

name: Shiori
message: "A shrine filled with strong divine energy... She went out of her way to tell us about it, so I guess we should go."

name: Shiori
message: "How are you feeling? Do your shoulders feel heavy or anything?"
"Something feels a bit off, I think?"
"I'm good."

name: Shiori
message: "My... I guess we should go, then."

name: Shiori
message: "Kashima Reiko-san recommended the spot herself, so I'm sure it'll work wonders."

name: Shiori
message: "It'd be awful if something happened to you. Let's head there right away."
(Shrine)

name: Shiori
message: "Is that so? I'm glad to hear that."

name: Shiori
message: "It might still be worth going, though. Just in case."

name: Shiori
message: "But I don't want to nag. It's your body, so I'll leave the decision to you."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, now that we've checked the accident site, that should be everything for today."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, no. There *is* one more thing. We've got to stop by the convenience store."

name: Shiori
message: "I have to get the photo printed. And if Gyaruko-san is there, I should thank her and give her an update."
(Convenience store)
(Shrine)

name: Shiori
message: "We got what we needed from Kashima Reiko-san, so the supermarket's up next."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's go see that knowledgeable lady."
(Convenience store)
(Shrine)

name: Shiori
message: "Next up is the accident site."

name: Shiori
message: "I know Kashima Reiko-san gave us the exact location where the urban legend appears, but I'm still a bit uneasy about that lady's story."

name: Shiori
message: "I guess I shouldn't doubt her before we've even checked. Anyway, let's go."
(Scene of the accident)
(Shrine)

name: Shiori
message: "Now, where's Gyaruko-san..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, good, she's here."

name: Shiori
message: "Hello."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh? You came all the way here? You could've just called, y'know."

name: Shiori
message: "We needed to stop by the convenience store anyway."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ahh, gotcha. So, did you meet them? The lady and the girl I told you about."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. I also learned a lot about the accident. Thank you."
"Thank you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No prob."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But from the looks of it, I guess your memories aren't back yet."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes... The moment I talked to that lady, I realized the chances were slim."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeaaah, that lady exaggerates everything."

name: Shiori
message: "That's true, but I did learn something about the accident: the victim's name."

name: Shiori
message: "Aoi Lumina. It wasn't me."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Aoi... Lumina..."

name: Shiori
message: "Do you know her?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Nope, not at all. Never heard of her."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But I gotta hand it to her, that lady really loves her gossip."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So, did she say anything else? About the incident or whatever?"

name: Shiori
message: "Hmm, I think she mentioned something about a lovers' quarrel, or that it might've been a targeted attack, among other things."

name: Shiori
message: "I couldn't really tell what was true and what wasn't."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Haha, you can say that again."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "She's totally blowing things out of proportion. Don't you think, Shiorin?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, I think so too."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What about the other ghost? How'd it go?"

name: Shiori
message: "She told us about an urban legend."

name: Shiori
message: "We even tried it out. Sadly, my memories are still missing."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Figures. I kinda got my hopes up, but I guess it ain't gonna be that easy."

name: Shiori
message: "It was a valuable experience, though. Thank you for introducing her to me."

name: Shiori
message: "She told us about an urban legend, though we didn't get to try it out."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah, it does sound kinda sketchy. Can't blame you."

name: Shiori
message: "It's not that I don't believe her, it just ended up lower on the priority list."

name: Shiori
message: "It would've been fine if it were just me, but I'd feel bad about dragging my buddy into danger."

name: Shiori
message: "Actually, we didn't go to see her. We already got the info we needed from the lady. I'm sorry."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Nah, don't worry about it. I only brought her up just in case."

name: Shiori
message: "If something comes up next time, we'll go see her. Thanks for telling us about her."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hm? Why the scary look all of a sudden?"

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, um, I just realized... If we were just talking to ghosts, I could've done it alone."

name: Shiori
message: "And then there's me, dragging my buddy around like it was the most natural thing in the world... I'm sorry."
"I'm good."
"I'm tired."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. You're very kind."

name: Shiori
message: "Right... we *have* been walking for quite a while..."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry. And thank you, too. For staying with me nonetheless."

name: Shiori
message: "I should stop relying on you for everything... I need to do the things I can on my own."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ehh? Isn't it better if you two stick together?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Shiorin, you can't use a smartphone, right? What'll you do when you wanna use the internet or contact me? It'd be rough if you were alone."

name: Shiori
message: "Well... that's true. It'd be hard for me to deal with anything unexpected on my own."

name: Shiori
message: "Where did you even get that phone, Gyaruko-san? Ghosts can use it, right?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh, this one's kind of a smartphone, but kinda not."

name: Shiori
message: "Hm?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Did I forget to tell you? It doesn't work."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I just kinda noticed I had it one day. Probably like... I dunno, a piece of my soul or something?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "It's the same as the clothes I'm wearing. Like, some kinda soul accessory or whatever. It's just something that happens to look like a phone."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh right, you said even making that call was a miracle. Basically, just another unexplainable paranormal phenomenon."

name: Shiori
message: "A soul accessory... Maybe you had some kind of attachment to your smartphone when you were alive?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Who knows? Dunno, not like I remember."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So, hey, I know this is kinda random, but what'd you think of that lady?"

name: Shiori
message: "What I think... hmmm... I guess the strongest impression I got was that she just kept rambling on and on by herself."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Did she try talking to living people too?"

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, yes, she did. She didn't care at all, even when they didn't react."

name: Shiori
message: "And... ah, right. Her sense of time seemed messed up too."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah, that lady's memories are intact, but everything else is busted."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "They say once a ghost loses their memories, they start losing themselves, right? But it looks like you can end up like that even *with* memories."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Which means I might end up going weird someday too."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I try not to think about it too much, but I guess I should start doing something about it."

name: Shiori
message: "Want to look for your lost memories with us?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Nah, that'd be too inefficient. I'll just wing it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Just keep me posted, yeah? Like if you learn about someone who died in an accident or whatever."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Who knows? Maybe if I hear a name, everything'll come rushing back. Like—bam!"

name: Shiori
message: "Okay. If I find anything, I'll tell you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Thanks."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Mmkay, I'm gonna head out now. See ya~"

name: Shiori
message: "See you."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... I forgot to tell her about yesterday."

name: Shiori
message: "...No, maybe we should dig a little deeper before we bring it up. We don't even know the suicide victim's name."

name: Shiori
message: "It could even be Gyaruko-san or someone she knew... Let's look into it when we have the time."

name: Shiori
message: "But for today, we're done. Let's write down today's events in the Death Diary and call it a day."

name: Shiori
message: "I'd like you to print the photos, please. There should be two for today's entry."

name: Shiori
message: "It'll take some time for me to put everything together, so let's head to the park once you've printed them."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, it's done."

name: Shiori
message: "Looking at it all compiled like this really makes it sink in."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm definitely getting myself back, little by little. I can feel it."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you again for today. I'll be counting on you—"

name: Shiori
message: "You saw that too, didn't you?"

name: Shiori
message: "That was... a kid, right? Probably a ghost, just like me."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, can you wait here for a moment?"

name: Shiori
message: "Nope, no luck. She seems to be quite good at hide-and-seek. I couldn't find her anywhere."

name: Shiori
message: "I wonder why... for some reason, I can't stop thinking about that little ghost."

name: Shiori
message: "Also, when I mentioned hide-and-seek just now..."

name: Shiori
message: "I can't quite put it into words... but something's tugging at the back of my mind..."

name: Shiori
message: "Why does my heart feel so restless?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, I'm sorry, looks like it's getting dark. Let's call it a day."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you again for today. See you next time. Get home safe, okay?"
I should record what happened today on my phone.
Time to head home.

name: Shiori
message: "Here we are."

name: Shiori
message: "She said it was run-down, so I pictured some creepy, dilapidated ruin, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "It's actually really pretty. Well, I guess that makes sense. It's in the middle of town, so of course it's maintained."

name: Shiori
message: "So there's supposed to be a strong divine aura here."

name: Shiori
message: "To be honest, I'm not really feeling it. How about you? Do you feel anything?"
"I'm REALLY feeling it."
"I'm not really feeling it."

name: Shiori
message: "That much? Wow..."

name: Shiori
message: "You know, I think I'm starting to feel it too. The air does feel a little clearer..."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, I lied. I can't feel anything. I just said that at random."

name: Shiori
message: "Right... I guess you wouldn't."

name: Shiori
message: "It's divine energy, after all. Well, I'm not really surprised. A deity's aura is probably too much for regular people like us."

name: Shiori
message: "So, um, we can get purified here, right?"

name: Shiori
message: "It really is deserted, isn't it? I don't think this place has a priest or shrine maiden."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait here for a sec."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, there really is no one here... Should we just hang around for a while? Maybe the divine energy will cleanse us on its own."

name: Shiori
message: "I should've asked for more details... I have no idea what we're supposed to do."

name: Shiori
message: "It'd feel a bit empty to head back without doing anything... Hey, hey, over here. Come with me."

name: Shiori
message: "Look, there's an offering box. Since we're already here, we might as well pray."

name: Shiori
message: "...Wait, how did it go again? I think it was... two bows, two claps, then one bow? Did I get it right?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, but I'm completely broke. Looks like I can't give an offering..."

name: Shiori
message: "Well... I *am* a ghost, so I guess there's nothing we can do about it. It's the thought that counts. I'm sure we're not required to give a donation, anyway."

name: Shiori
message: "If you're broke too, we can just pay our respects to the local deity."

name: Shiori
message: "But if you *are* putting something in, maybe pick a magic number. It might bring better luck, ehehe."
How much should I put in?
(5 yen)

name: Shiori
message: "The classic 5 yen offering, I see. May it bring good ties and fortune."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, I get it. Four hundred eighty-five, a pun on shihou happou, meaning all directions, right? May it bring good ties and fortune from every direction."

name: Shiori
message: "In short, you want to become popular. Your desires are gushing out of you. That's wonderful."

name: Shiori
message: "Wow, you really went all out."

name: Shiori
message: "Since it's such an odd amount, it must be a number pun, right? Hold on, let me guess."

name: Shiori
message: "I got it! Ii fuku! As in, may good fortune come our way! I'm right, aren't I?"

name: Shiori
message: "......Huh? one thousand one hundred twenty-nine... Ii niku...? Hm? Niku as in meat? Good meat?"

name: Shiori
message: "Wow, you've got guts, especially in front of a deity... That's so rock' n' roll!"

name: Shiori
message: "But I'm sure the deity's smiling too. You've sure got a sense of humor. I like it."
(Give the money to Shiori)
(Put the money into the offering box)

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? You're... giving it to me?"

name: Shiori
message: "That's so sweet of you, thanks. But I'll pass."

name: Shiori
message: "I can't accept your money. I'm already depending on you so much as it is. I'd feel bad, and I'm sure the deity wouldn't like it."

name: Shiori
message: "So pray for yourself. I'll just give the deity my greetings."
(Put the money into the offering box)

name: Shiori
message: "Two bows..."

name: Shiori
message: "Clap twice, and lastly, one bow."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, that should do it. I'm sure any bad energy around you has been purified."

name: Shiori
message: "I won't ask whether you felt anything. When it comes to things like this, believing is what matters most."

name: Shiori
message: "Your misfortune has been cleansed. You're now safe and sound. Thank you, local deity."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's come again sometime. After all, you're literally dealing with ghosts right now."

name: Shiori
message: "I think it's best to regularly cleanse your body and mind in a sacred place like this. At least, that's how I feel."

name: Shiori
message: "Now then, with that taken care of, it looks like we've finally done everything we needed to do today."

name: Shiori
message: "It's getting dark. Let's head to the convenience store. I'll put together today's events in the Death Diary and call it a day."

name: Shiori
message: "Come on, let's go."
(Convenience store)

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, now that we've finished our prayers, let's head to the supermarket."

name: Shiori
message: "We should hear what that knowledgeable lady has to say."
(Supermarket)

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, now that we've finished our prayers, next up is the accident site."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm not sure how much of her story is true, though..."

name: Shiori
message: "It was near the flower garden, right? Shall we head there now?"
(Scene of the accident)

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? Really...? Do you... really think so?"

name: Shiori
message: "Just to be sure... could you look it up online? That idol from the 80s, the one everyone even copied their hairstyle from."
(Idol, 80s)

name: Shiori
message: "She was active around... the late Showa era?"

name: Shiori
message: "So this is what she looks like... hmmmm... does she really look like me...? Maybe...?"
"Not really."
"She does."

name: Shiori
message: "Right, I thought so. Of course we don't look alike."

name: Shiori
message: "Phew... that was close. I almost let myself believe it."

name: Shiori
message: "To be honest, I kind of got my hopes up. Like, what if... I used to be an idol...? Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "But there's just no way that's true. I don't feel anything from looking at her photos or reading her profile. Nothing's coming back."

name: Shiori
message: "That was close. I almost made an embarrassing mistake."

name: Shiori
message: "Thanks for looking it up. Let's just drop it. I should stop daydreaming and start focusing on what I have to do."

name: Shiori
message: "Really? I do?"
"Nah, not really."
"Practically identical."

name: Shiori
message: "Th-That much? We look that alike?"
"I was just imagining things."
"You might be her."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... were you just teasing me? Geez, I almost believed you."

name: Shiori
message: "Phew, that was close. Good thing I came to my senses before I started imagining myself performing live at the Budokan."

name: Shiori
message: "For some reason, I'm starting to think so too..."

name: Shiori
message: "A Showa-era idol who vanished from the public eye at the peak of her popularity..."

name: Shiori
message: "Nobody even knows if she's alive... There's no information about it online."

name: Shiori
message: "I'll ask you again. Are you actually serious that I might be her?"
"I'm kidding."
"I'm serious."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, I knew it! You were teasing me!"

name: Shiori
message: "I was about eighty percent convinced, you know? One more push and I would've been full-on idol mode. I might've even made you my manager."

name: Shiori
message: "That was really close... Good thing I managed to snap out of it just in time."

name: Shiori
message: "...Are you serious? Like, serious serious?"
"Just kidding."
"Dead serious."

name: Shiori
message: "I see... So you're dead serious, then..."

name: Shiori
message: "You really do think I'm that legendary idol..."

name: Shiori
message: "Right..."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm really feeling it now!"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm... an idol."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm an idol."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm. An. Idol!"

name: Shiori
message: "That's right! I! Was! An idol!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh?"

name: Shiori
message: "Greetings, Gyaruko-san."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Gree... What? Who're you?"

name: Shiori
message: "Oh come now, it's me."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh? Wait, Shiorin?!"

name: Shiori
message: "Indeed, it is I, Kugayama Shiori."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Huh? What...? The heck? Wh-What's with you?"

name: Shiori
message: "You see, Gyaruko-san. I was actually an idol."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...The heck are you talking about? And why are you talking like that?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, but this is simply how Showa idols speak!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "How was I supposed to know?! ...Wait, what? Did you get your memories back?"

name: Shiori
message: "No, not at all."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "And now you're talking normally again... You scared me..."

name: Shiori
message: "They say I look identical to that legendary idol from the 80s."

name: Shiori
message: "My buddy even guaranteed it, that I'm the real thing, so maybe it's true!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Maybe...? You're not even convinced yourself..."

name: Shiori
message: "To be honest, I never actually believed it myself."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Then why are you dressed like that...?"

name: Shiori
message: "I mean, my buddy here vouched for me so much that I figured I'd try living like an idol for a while."

name: Shiori
message: "Besides, who knows? Maybe it's actually true."

name: Shiori
message: "Well, Gyaruko-san? Do I seem like a proper Showa idol to you?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "How should I know?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Having fun?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, I am."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I see..."
